title: Software Engineering in the Agent Era From Trustworthy Change to Human Agent Software Organizations
abstract: arXiv:2609.04630v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software agents make digital execution elastic: repository analysis, code generation, testing, migration, tool use, and operations can be replicated and parallelized without proportional human headcount. Problem framing, semantic commitment, verification, integration, attention, and residual-risk acceptance remain bounded by human cognition, organizational authority, and economic capacity. How should scalable execution be governed so organizations can accept and sustain its changes?   Our testable framework has two constructs and one execution abstraction. Trustworthy Change (TC) is the engineering object moving from intent through delegated execution, verification, integration, acceptance, and operation. Responsibility Topology classifies organizations by the distribution of independent residual-risk acceptance authority. A single-center topology has one final baseline responsibility anchor; a multi-anchor topology requires joint accept

translated_title: 智能体时代的软件工程：从可信变更到人类-智能体软件组织
translated_abstract: 软件智能体使数字执行变得具有弹性：仓库分析、代码生成、测试、迁移、工具使用和运维等任务可以在无需按比例增加人力的情况下进行复制和并行化。然而，问题的界定、语义承诺、验证、集成、注意力分配以及残余风险的接受，仍然受限于人类认知、组织权威和经济能力。那么，应如何治理可扩展的执行，才能让组织接受并持续承载这些变更？我们的可测试框架包含两个核心构造和一个执行抽象。可信变更是从意图出发，经过委托执行、验证、集成、接受和运维的工程对象。责任拓扑则根据独立残余风险接受权的分布方式对组织进行分类：单中心拓扑拥有一个最终的基线责任锚点；多锚点拓扑则需要联合接受。
tldr: 提出了“可信变更”与“责任拓扑”两个可测试的概念框架，用以治理智能体时代弹性数字执行所带来的变更，帮助人类-智能体软件组织接受并持续管理残余风险。
en_tdlr: Proposes a testable framework built on "Trustworthy Change" and "Responsibility Topology" to govern elastic agent-driven execution, enabling human-agent software organizations to accept and sustain change and residual risk.
